caption: The drawing features a single garment displayed flat and viewed from the front. It is a white, rectangular tunic with short, wide sleeves. The body of the tunic is mainly plain and light in color, rendered in shades of white and subtle grey to suggest folds and creases in the fabric. The sleeves are decorated with brownish-gold lace that covers their entire width, with an intricate pattern in the lacework. The edges of the garment, including the neckline, sleeve openings, and hem, are outlined in a slightly darker line for definition. The background is an unadorned beige or light tan color, providing contrast to the lighter garment. There are no other objects or features in the composition.
title: Baby's Shirt
